originalProposals.reason: A jellyfish bloom is a real aggregation, but G4-M-7 is a guided environmental-survey process skill (grouping/classifying issues), not animal grouping. G8-L-6 is six-kingdom/three-domain classification. G8-M-7/M-8 and G9-M-4 group are periodic-table groups. Time hits (G6-E-10, G8-E-8, G8-F-7, G10-F-6) are calendar/typhoon/power/momentum traps. TL/BIS dikya keep bloom. Potential G6-L-6 after an aggregation/bloom interaction example.

Most jellyfish have ocelli rather than camera eyes, but G3-L-4 (head/legs/wings; move/food) is not admitted. G3-L-3 respond needs respond|response|react. G3-F-7:bright-light is harmful-light/eye safety (eye keyword). G4-F-8/F-9/F-10 light are action-at-a-distance and energy forms/uses. G6-L-7/L-8 light are abiotic ecosystem factors. TL/BIS leave jellyfish untranslated; mata/kahayag OK. Potential G3-L-4 after a sensory-spot facet, or G3-L-3 after explicit respond wording.

Commercial-jet cruise ~900 km/h is in the typical band, but G4-F-3 needs distance.*time as the definition of speed and is not admitted (same as prior cheetah/SR-71 holds). G7-M-7 is investigation SI units. G4-F-2 is measuring with ruler/tape. Smooth matches G5-F-2 friction surfaces; air/meter/plane are traps. TL/BIS 900 kilometro kada oras OK. Potential G4-F-3 after a speed-example facet.

James Prescott Joule was English (Salford), but G4-M-1 needs invent|develop|creat plus a named invention and is not admitted. G8-F-7:units matches the surname Joule while the competency is power as rate of work (watt/joule units), a name-vs-unit trap. G4-L-3:land matches England. TL/BIS taga-England OK. Potential G4-M-1 after scientist+invention/discovery wording, or G8-F-7 after joule-as-energy-unit (not power).

The June solstice falls around 20–21 (sometimes 22). G6-E-9 is why ancient cultures used constellations for seasons; G6-E-10 is indigenous PH eclipse/night-sky time-tracking. Calendar is a keyword. G7-E-11 tilt/day-length is not admitted. G3-F-7 loud-sound matches year→ear. TL/BIS Hunyo 20 o 21 OK. Potential G7-E-11 after a solstice-date facet, or G6-E-9 after solstice-as-season-marker.

Io, Europa, Ganymede, and Callisto are the Galilean moons, but G5-E-11 is not admitted (structure needs sun-center; objects asteroid|comet; features rocky|gas giant|ice giant). G3-E-6:moon is guided observation of Earth's Moon commonly seen in the sky (activity). G3-E-8 nighttime is sky objects affecting people's activities. Table/list hits are habitat/endangered-species. TL/BIS keep the four names. Potential G5-E-11 after a moons-of-planets facet.

Ganymede is the largest solar-system moon, larger than Mercury, and has its own magnetic field (NASA). G5-E-11 is not admitted. G3-E-6:moon is Earth-Moon sky observation. G4-F-8/G6-M-6 magnet are action-at-a-distance and mixture magnets, not a moon dynamo. G8-L-3 stem is xylem (Ganymede). TL/BIS keep Ganymede/Mercury/magnetic field. Potential G5-E-11 after a moon-features facet.

Named for Roman Jupiter and the largest planet is sound, but G5-E-11 is not admitted. G3-E-6:planets is guided observation of commonly seen sky objects, not etymology or size rank. After/plan/stem/solar hits are cyclone/volcano/xylem/renewable traps. TL/BIS pinakamalaki/'hari' OK. Potential G5-E-11 after a planet-names/size facet.

Jupiter has the strongest planetary magnetic field; Earth's field does steer a compass. G5-E-11 is not admitted. G4-F-8:magnets is objects affecting others at a distance — the compass clause is a comparison, not the teaching. G3-E-6:planets is guided sky observation. G6-M-6 magnets and G5-F-10 electromagnet observations are traps. TL/BIS magnetic field/kompas OK. Potential G5-E-11 after a planet-magnetic-field feature, or G4-F-8 after an Earth-field/compass example.

Voyager 1 found Jupiter's faint dust rings in 1979; inner-moon dust is the source. G5-E-11 is not admitted. G3-E-6:moon / G3-E-8 night are Earth-sky observation/activity. G3-E-2 made is human-made objects. TL Napakalalim nila = very deep, not faint (translation error); BIS mahinay is closer. Potential G5-E-11 after a planet-rings/composition facet, after TL repair.

Jupiter's sidereal period is ~11.86 Earth years, so about 12 is OK. G5-E-11 is not admitted. G7-E-10 tilt-orbit is Earth's tilt versus its orbit and sunlight intensity (model/drawing). Sun/orbit/year hits are light-sources, ecosystem light, solar heating, and meteor-shower debris. TL/BIS 12 taon/tuig OK. Potential G5-E-11 after an orbital-period feature.

The Philippine colugo (kagwang) is not a lemur or a monkey. Only G4-L-3:air matches, via flying, but that unit is a drawing/diagram habitat classification (terrestrial/aquatic/aerial) and the card does not classify by habitat. G5-L-4 table groups are not admitted. TL/BIS keep flying lemur; meaning OK. Potential G4-L-3 after dropping the diagram gate and treating gliding as aerial, or G5-L-4 after a named-group misconception.

HOLD: app/merged wording disagrees (app omits clock of the mountains; merged includes it). Even unified, G3-F-8 is sending information between two people; G4-F-10 is sources/uses of sound energy at school/home/community, not a bird-as-clock. G6-E-10 is indigenous sky time-tracking. Same/time hits are fair-test/power/momentum traps. TL Umiiyak = cries. Potential G4-F-10 after a community sound-signal example, after variant reconciliation.

The rufous hornbill (kalaw) is the largest Philippine hornbill, but G6-L-4:local matches Philippine while teaching vertebrate vs invertebrate differences; no backbone. G4-L-7 is a labeled PH food-chain drawing. G9-L-8 is protect/conserve endangered species. Other Philippine hits are volcano/fault/typhoon/hydropower traps. TL/BIS kalaw/hornbill OK. Potential G6-L-4 after an explicit vertebrate local-bird example, or G9-L-8 after conservation status.

Hornbills are typically monogamous, but G5-L-6:birds is comparing bird life cycles from egg to a mature organism, not pair-bonding. G5-L-5 live-young/egg-laying is not admitted. G3-E-9 shade matches cloth in whole. TL/BIS monogamong ibon/langgam OK. Potential G5-L-6 after a bird-reproduction-behavior facet.

The kalaw's red face/casque is display, not camouflage. G5-L-9 (mimicry/camouflage from secondary sources) is not admitted. G3-L-8 forest is habitat-protection. G3-F-7 bright is harmful light. TL/BIS pula vs berdeng gubat/lasang OK. Potential G5-L-9 after a display-vs-camouflage example.

Tarictic hornbills (Penelopides) are smaller relatives of the rufous hornbill. G5-L-4 table classification of named groups is not admitted. G9-E-5 relative is geologic relative dating. G3-E-9 cloth. TL/BIS tariktik OK. Potential G5-L-4 after a related-species grouping, or G6-L-4 local vertebrate.

Sweet potato is a tuberous root crop eaten from underground, but G3-L-5 (leaves/roots/stems getting water and nutrients) and G4-L-2 (root/shoot importance; pattern root.*(water|nutrient|anchor)) are not admitted. G8-L-3:roots is transport (xylem/phloem), not edible storage. G3-L-3:grow is living-things-grow. G3-L-7 eat is interdependence. TL halamang-ugat / BIS tanom nga ugat OK. Potential G3-L-5/G4-L-2 after an edible-root/storage example.

Kangaroo gestation is ~33 days then the joey crawls to the pouch, but G5-L-5 live-young needs live young|live birth|give birth|mammal and is not admitted. G5-L-6 mammal life cycle is not admitted (no mammal|calf|carabao|puppy). After hits are cyclone/volcano/earthquake. TL sanggol/supot / BIS anak/puyo OK. Potential G5-L-5 after a marsupial live-birth example.

Macropod pouches open forward (unlike wombats). G5-L-9 animals-changed-to-suit-environment (mimicry/camouflage) is not admitted. G3-L-4 outer parts for move/food is not admitted. G5-F-6/G8-F-9 fall are gravity and falling-energy. TL/BIS supot paharap/paatubang OK. Potential G5-L-9 after a pouch-orientation adaptation, or G3-L-4 after a carrying-structure role.

Kape alamid is named for the civet (alamid/musang). Etymology is not G3-L-2 living vs non-living, G4-E-2 water as a basic need, or G4-M-2 a local science invention. G3-E-2 makes is human-made objects. TL/BIS alamid o musang OK. Potential a local-animal/product facet, not G4-E-2.

Boboy and doldol are real Philippine names; kapok prefers warm climates. G3-L-2 is living vs non-living examples, not alternate names. G3-L-3:grow is the grow characteristic. G4-L-4 list/table of habitat plants is not admitted. Philippine hits are volcano/fault/typhoon/hydropower traps. TL/BIS boboy/doldol OK. Potential G4-L-4 after a named local plant-in-habitat example.

Kapok (Ceiba tree) and cotton (Gossypium shrub) are different plants. G5-L-4 table classification of named groups is not admitted. G3-L-2 plant/tree is living-vs-nonliving. G5-E-2 comparison is rocks. G7-L-7 similar/differ is sexual vs asexual offspring. TL kapok/bulak / BIS kapok/gapas OK. Potential G5-L-4 after a plant-form grouping.

Carabao as a plow animal that wallows is sound. G6-L-4:local matches carabao but requires vertebrate vs invertebrate differences; no backbone. G5-L-6:mammals is life-cycle comparison. G4-L-4:rice-field is a list/table of habitat examples (activity). G4-E-2 is water as a basic need, not mud-cooling. G3-F-1:roll is how objects are made to move. G6-M-2:cool is change of state. TL kalabaw / BIS kabaw OK. Potential G6-L-4 after an explicit vertebrate local example, or G4-L-4 after dropping the table activity.

Losing streams into limestone is real karst hydrology. G5-E-1 landforms plus environmental influence is not admitted (no mountain|valley|river|coast). G5-E-6 water cycle and G5-E-5 erosion-transport are not admitted. Water hits are basic-needs/habitat/ecosystem/photosynthesis/covalent traps. G7-E-2 slip is fault slip. TL apog / BIS anapog OK. Potential G5-E-1 after a karst/stream landform+influence facet, or G5-E-5 after dissolution/underground-flow.

Karst from limestone dissolution is correct, but G5-E-4 rock-to-soil (rock.*(soil|break)) is not admitted; this is landscape, not soil formation. G5-E-5 erosion-transport is not admitted. G3-M-8:shap is making solids useful by shaping. Water hits are basic-needs/habitat/ecosystem traps. TL/BIS keep limestone/karst. Potential G5-E-4/G5-E-5 after chemical-weathering/dissolution wording.

The Chocolate Hills are karst mounds; grass browns in the dry season. G5-E-1 requires identifying mountains/valleys/rivers/coastlines and how they influence living and non-living components; hills/karst patterns are not admitted, and brown grass is appearance, not environmental influence. G4-L-7 grass is a PH food-chain drawing. TL/BIS Bohol/karst landform OK. Potential G5-E-1 after a local-hills/karst facet plus influence.

Keeping medicine out of children's reach is real safety, but G6-M-4:uses is useful everyday mixtures (solutions/suspensions); medicin is a keyword. G3-F-4:reach is sound transfer. G4-M-5 harmful-changes and G3-M-7 handling/disposal are not admitted. TL gamot / BIS tambal OK. Potential G6-M-4 after a medicine-mixture safety facet, or a household-chemicals safety competency.

The kelvin is named for William Thomson, Lord Kelvin. G4-M-1 invent|develop|creat is not admitted (namesake is not an identified invention). G8-M-1:nucleus Thomson|Rutherford is J.J. Thomson's atomic model, a homonym trap. G9-E-8 scale is an Earth-layer thickness drawing. After hits are disaster stages. TL/BIS Kelvin scale/physicist OK. Potential G4-M-1 after scientist+temperature-scale invention, not G8-M-1.

The architectural keystone metaphor is etymology, not G6-L-5 food-web roles or G6-L-8 good/harm interactions (neither admitted). G5-F-6 fall/down is gravity on motion. Disproportionate ecosystem effect is the standard keystone definition, but G7-L-8 is a labelled-diagram of biological-organization levels (cell to biosphere); ecosystem is a keyword and the diagram activity is not taught. Khaki Campbell and Pateros ducks are egg-layer breeds, but G5-L-5:egg-laying needs egg.*(bird|reptile) and is not admitted (duck does not match bird). G7-E-6:during duck is earthquake drop-cover-hold. G3-F-8 sound matches Campbell. TL/BIS itik OK. Potential G5-L-5 after a bird-lays-eggs example that includes ducks.
